items.summary: Retain two deferred product opportunities for CEO/CTO review after capacity clears: an execution-ledger integrity layer and AI-usage guardrails. Both begin as read-only or dry-run prototypes using existing records, require no deployment, spend, credentials, domains, or new telemetry, and must remain outside the active queue until a delivery slot is released.

GitHub evidence supports research leads only. microsoft/markitdown has MIT licensing, 8/8 bounded checks passed, and a supported SEO/content fit; shadcn-ui/ui has MIT licensing and 3/3 bounded checks passed for reusable accessible UX. No adoption is recommended without a disposable fleet-specific prototype, dependency/security review, and measurable acceptance criteria.
